ja233:1.1: Surely go wherever you so desire,
ja233:1.2: You are shot in the vitals with a barb,
ja233:1.3: You have been killed by your food and by sound,
ja233:1.4: The greedy one is following the fish.
ja233:2.1: So also when falling on worldliness,
ja233:2.2: Following the mind’s desire, he suffers,
ja233:2.3: He dies in the midst of kin and of friends,
ja233:2.4: Like the crocodile following the fish.
